briefings.headline: Hunt Lowder’s fastball; make him earn the changeup
briefings.message: Rhett Lowder is the high-confidence expected starter (85%). Stay ready for his fastball group, which allows .399 xwOBA to lefties and .362 to righties. Lefties, sit fastball and stay off the fading changeup; everyone, do not chase his slider. The lineup is built to pressure him with fastball-focused at-bats. Be prepared for rested Reds relievers Emilio Pagán and Brock Burke.
reminders: Make Lowder prove he can land the changeup.
Expect rested bullpen options, including Pagán and Burke.

briefings.headline: Yamamoto leads; vary looks and attack with purpose
briefings.message: Yoshinobu Yamamoto starts with a 100-pitch limit and a six-inning target. Disrupt Elly De La Cruz with breaking balls and avoid predictable fastball sequences; mix offspeed to Tyler Stephenson and Sal Stewart. If Yamamoto exits early, use rested middle relief to bridge, then turn to rested leverage arms in close games. Tanner Scott and Edgardo Henriquez are limited, so reserve them for necessity.
